problems.symptom: Checkers read a tree or path that nothing refreshes: a literal /workspace path vs WORKSPACE_ROOT, the submodule tree vs the clone vs /vessels
problems.root_cause: Three or four trees per vessel, each with its own consumer, and path defaults computed by different rules; pull-sync never runs submodule update and fails silently with failed=0

problems.symptom: Typecheck-valid landings that change nothing, or that break the system (inverted boolean, garbage URL, overwritten aggregation), pass every gate
problems.root_cause: Every gate reads the diff and nothing executes the changed line; the post-land suite ran=false

problems.symptom: Refused or partial changes land via patch_with_tools; about half of self-modification is unjudged
problems.root_cause: The escalation lane verifies only 'fs_edit applied + typecheck'; the region gate and escalation suppression depend on a region field present on 2.6% of gaps; pwt mutates live /vessels before any gate

problems.symptom: Reach verdicts wrong in both directions (a broken commit rewarded, the fix failed; hollow reached:true on a template_audit_report; 'despite an error')
problems.root_cause: The landing requirement is attached to a route, not the goal; the LLM judge omits values; deterministic oracle coverage depends on phrasing; label ids mismatched colon vs hyphen

problems.symptom: Verdicts and learning signal computed and then lost (reach-patch MATCHED NO ROW, non-fatal label writes, joinDecisionOutcome drops, in-process compose bypasses verdict delivery)

principles: A capability that has never executed looks exactly like one that does not work; the evidence is a count, not a code reading (compose-pipeline 2026-08-10)
Before building, check that it does not already exist: run the existing resolver with corrected inputs and dry-run (08-09, 08-10)
Self-modification without execution is negative drift: every gate reads the diff, only a test runs it (09-09)
Prompt instruction cannot stop drafter paraphrase; the lever must be mechanical, e.g. enumerated anchors (09-09)
One operation per plan; single-op plans land atomically, multi-op plans shed edits (09-10)
${A:-$B} fails over on empty, never on invalid (09-14)
Make an existing metric honest before adding a detector (cutover reach on push_status) (09-14)
The dominant instrument failure is a checker pointed at a tree nothing refreshes; name the tree (09-10)
A performance bound smaller than the population is a correctness bug (09-10)
Provider or billing failures must not be recorded as quality failures in the learner (08-11)
Information at the moment of use: when the drafter repeatedly invents the same missing thing, believe it (08-07, 08-11)
Ship the falsifying measurement in the same commit as the causal claim; a diagnostic that cannot come out false teaches nothing (08-07)
Never escalate a blocker on an inferred cause; check whether the designed automatic handling ran (08-07, 08-12)
A gap whose summary contains the patch tests plumbing; a symptom summary tests capability (08-10)
Editing a gap is a dispatch; a gap's first sentence must state the defect; correct metadata, not just prose (08-10, 08-11)
Refusal must bind across lanes; the graded lane's refusal must not trigger the ungraded lane (09-05, 09-10)
Don't fix an inverted env gate by setting the env; delete the gate (law 1) (09-05)
A negative is unattributed until a positive control shares its address; a zero across a whole table is a broken probe (recurring)
Attribute by explicit id or unique content, never by time adjacency or substring; match log prefixes and fields (09-06, 09-10, 09-12)
Localisation decides what every downstream gate means; rarity is not specificity (08-11)
A fluent reach reason is prose, not evidence; a judge that can say 'despite an error' is not a gate (08-09, 08-10)
A satisfier that reports emptiness must not count as producing the shape (08-08)
Non-fatal on a learning write is fatal to learning (08-17)
A loop that stores only its successes cannot compound on failure (09-22)
If reuse works on repeats but not near-misses, look at the retrieval key before the learner (08-08)
'Nothing found' and 'nothing could be asked' must not log the same way (08-08, 09-10)
Measure what a guard carries before tightening it; enumerate the producers that must still pass (09-04, 09-10)
A metric change must be tested for whether it can flatter you today, per rung (09-11, 09-12)
A baseline that includes the disease cannot diagnose it (median, not pooled) (09-10)
A health sample selected by the health it measures cannot report ill health (09-10)
Prefer class2 behavioural predicates; class1 literals can be satisfied by a comment (09-10)
'Built, works, unreachable' is its own class: check for a caller before debugging the callee (09-08)
Exploration must add a candidate, never remove the best (09-23)
A writer that writes on a non-attempt feeds the trigger it answers (09-23)
After every landing, diff the runtime against the commit and exercise the consumer (09-23, 09-24)
Killing the client does not cancel the work; the gap is the durable unit (09-12)
State the expected effect before dispatch; a repair with no predicted observable is a story (09-10, 09-12)
Before landing a detector, print and read the rows it would fire on (09-12)
Split by subpopulation and determinism before reading a trend; never compute reuse over a truncated store (09-08)
The improvements were all in SEEING, none in DOING; instrument convergence is not capability improvement (09-08)
A re-run confirms determinism, not causation (09-13)
A truncated search is not an absence; take a path from the code that writes it (09-13)
Children must reference the parent, not copy it (copy-on-mint) (09-14)
Can the container reproduce its running state from config and volumes alone? Volume persistence is not restartability (08-08)
An unconditional health handler disables every watchdog above it (08-10)
Check who authored the last N instances of any chore you are doing by hand (law 6, quietest form) (08-12)
Re-check whether a gap is already fixed at dispatch time; the autonomous loop races the operator (09-12)
